ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels and 35% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixels dominate the upper lateral regions of both lobes. A contiguous low-intensity dark pigmentation region occupies the lower central area surrounding the notch. Discrete, low-intensity pixel clusters (spots and mottling) are scattered throughout the high-intensity regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with a clear vertex; estimated interior angle of 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with variable pixel amplitudes ranging from minor micro-peaks to significant macro-notches near the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward concave sweep from the median notch, transitioning to a convex curve as the lobes terminate at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular calcified structures (barnacles) localized at the distal tips of both lobes. Circular, ring-like grey pigmentation marks are visible within the dark central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, non-aligned linear dark pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the high-intensity white regions, particularly prominent on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of active barnacle colonization on the distal tips and multiple linear rake marks across the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive and dense barnacle encrustation on the extreme outer edges of both fluke tips.
